_note: Topic presets used by planet_strength.js for step 6 (subject relationship and dasha activity). Each field carries a source tag. owner means the owner stated it in the methodology. proposed means the engine author filled it from standard Parashari practice and the owner should confirm or correct it. Any preset can be overridden on the command line with houses, karakas and varga.
